transcript.message: Hi, I'm Agora. Ready for a quick exercise?
A team made contract review forty percent faster. Success or failure?
Failure, because nothing on the financial statements moved.
So you're saying failure, because the financials didn't move. Right?
Actually I think speed can matter if it frees people for better work.
Type what you now believe in two or three sentences in the text box, then send it.
A faster workflow only counts if something in the business changes.
I'm not sure the financial statements are the only test.
That's sharper than your first answer, but 'something in the business' is vague.
